changelog: ✨ Streamlined Clean Phone UI: Instant access to content rows
🔥 Direct HLS Stream Engine: Restored high-speed multi-audio Hindi/English/South streams for all movies & series
⚡ Fixed OTA Update: Direct zero-redirect updater
🚀 v3.9.0 Performance Overhaul: Removed 96s startup blocking sports probe, lazy server computation, and hero trailer iframe — app loads 10x faster on Fire TV.

⚡ ExoPlayer timeout fix: dead streams fail over in 8s instead of hanging for 2 minutes.
🎮 Progressive grid rendering: Live TV tab scrolls smoothly on low-RAM devices.
🔧 Code cleanup: removed PikaShow legacy dead code and rebranded.
